einzeiler: A general trivia pub quiz covering mythology, geography, pop culture, and more.
kurzfassung: This episode features a four-round pub quiz with questions spanning mythology, geography, pop culture, and history. The hosts test listeners' knowledge with diverse topics ranging from ancient deities to classic cinema and space missions. The show wraps up with a challenging final round connecting multiple clues to a single meteorological answer.
stichpunkte: Round one covers Egyptian mythology, New York theater history, scooter sidecars, and traditional Genoa cake ingredients.
Round two includes questions about a sci-fi book series, ovine animal terminology, the Scopes Monkey Trial, and musical theater history.
The rapid-fire Bang Bang round challenges players to name all twelve Greek Olympians within a strict time limit.
Round three features sports statistics, NASA Mars landing history, screenwriter facts, and knitting techniques.
Round four explores the former name of Chennai, official languages of Finland, Flemish Baroque art, and early gold record milestones.
The final Big Bang round uses clues about musical characters, literary figures, and TV dads to identify a retired Atlantic hurricane name.

clips.text: The hosts introduce a history question about the famous American legal proceeding centered on the teaching of human evolution.
The speaker lists out the primary deities of Mount Olympus after the rapid-fire timer runs out.

clips.hook: The emotional toll of space exploration failures
clips.text: The hosts express disbelief and empathy for engineers whose multi-year space projects failed due to simple measurement or software errors.

clips.hook: The very first gold record award
clips.text: The trivia reveals which musician received the initial certified gold record in 1958 along with the hit single that earned it.

clips.hook: A sudden medical emergency on Broadway
clips.text: The discussion turns to an unexpected backstage mishap involving the lead actress swallowing a foreign object during a musical's run.

beschreibung:
A new week means new questions! Hope you have fun with these!
In Egyptian mythology, which warrior goddess of the sun had the head of a cat?
Which well-known theater district do some claim derives its name from the dutch term "Breede Weg"?
What is the name for a one-wheeled device attached to a motorcycle or scooter?
Which kind of nut is traditionally found on top of a Genoa cake?
Dennis Taylor's We are Legion, For We Are Many, All These Worlds, Heaven's River, and Not Till We Are Lost, are all novels in which series?
Ovine refers to which animal?
The scopes monkey trial was an American legal case involving which scientific theory?
Which Musical did not win any Tonys when it originally played on Broadway, but has since won Best Revival of a Musical in 1996 and the Best Picture Academy Award in 2003?
The final play from scrimmage of Super Bowl 47 had the same result as the first play from scrimmage of the very next Super Bowl. What was this result, which happens in less than 1/10 of a percent of all NFL plays?
What was the first NASA program to land an object on Mars sucessfully?
In Knitting, what type of knot is made when you cast on?
What Academy Award winner wrote the screenplay to the first two Superman films?
The Indian city of Chennai was changed in 1996 from what name?
What is the second official language of Finland?
